chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: # Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: - **Standard affiliate rate:** 12% of all revenue directly attributed to the creator's promo code or UTM link - **Ambassador rate:** Negotiated per contract — typically 8–15% depending on tier and exclusivity - **Trial period rate (first 90 days):** 12% standard — no reduced trial rate

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: All affiliate promo codes follow this format:  ``` GS + [first 4 letters of creator name, uppercase] + [2 random digits] ```  Examples: - Creator: Naomi Williams → Code: GSNAOM47 - Creator: Alex Chen → Code: GSALEXC83 - Creator: Jo → Code: GSJOXXX12 (short names padded with X)  Codes must be: - Uniq

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: Every affiliate deal requires BOTH: 1. **Promo code** — applied at checkout, tracked in Shopify 2. **UTM link** — unique URL with `utm_source=creator_name&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_campaign=campaign_id`  Having only one of the two is insufficient — some customers use the link without the code and vic

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: - Commissions calculated monthly (1st of each month) - Payment processed within 15 business days - Minimum payout threshold: £50 (commissions below £50 roll to next month) - Payment method: Bank transfer or PayPal (creator's choice at onboarding)

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: - **Cookie window:** 30 days from link click - **Promo code window:** Valid for 12 months (no attribution window — any use of code is attributed) - **Last-click model:** If a customer uses both a UTM link and another channel, the promo code takes precedence

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: - Full order value at checkout when promo code is applied - Full order value when UTM link led to purchase within 30-day window - Excludes: shipping, taxes, refunded orders

chunks.title: Affiliate Commission Structure & Tracking Setup
chunks.snippet: If a creator disputes their commission report: 1. Creator raises dispute in writing within 30 days of statement 2. Finance team reviews Shopify transaction logs within 5 business days 3. If discrepancy confirmed, correction applied to following month's payment

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: # Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: Gymshark operates a two-layer safety check on all creator prospects:  1. **Content-level check** (Phase 0) — automated keyword scanning of video titles and transcripts during discovery 2. **Audience-level check** (Phase 1b, Skill 02) — VADER sentiment analysis of YouTube comments  Both must pass bef

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: ### GREEN — Safe to Proceed - No safety-negative keywords detected in content - Comment sentiment score ≥ 0.65 - Flagged comment percentage < 8%  ### AMBER — Human Review Required - Body image concern keywords present > 5% of comments, OR - Flagged comment percentage ≥ 8% but ≤ 15% - A human partner

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: The following keyword categories in video titles or transcripts trigger AMBER or RED flags:  - **Extreme diet:** "1000 calorie", "starvation diet", "crash diet", "extreme cut" - **Drug use:** "steroids", "sarms", "peptides", "gear" (in bodybuilding context) - **Hate speech:** Any discriminatory lang

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: | Metric | Threshold | Action | |--------|-----------|--------| | Avg compound sentiment | < 0.40 | Flag for review | | Negative creator flags | > 5% of comments | AMBER | | Toxicity rate | > 5% | RED | | Flagged comments | > 15% | RED | | Purchase intent signals | 0 in 50+ comments | Note in report

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: A creator is marked competitor_loyalty = True if their content shows: - Paid promotion of a direct Gymshark competitor - Wearing competitor-branded gear in majority of recent videos - Explicit endorsement language for competitors  Direct competitors: Lululemon, Fabletics, Alphalete, NVGTN, Pursue Fi

chunks.title: Audience Safety & Brand Risk Policy
chunks.snippet: A RED safety flag can only be overridden by the Head of Partnerships with written justification. AMBER flags can be cleared by any senior partnerships manager after manual review.

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.snippet: # Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.snippet: Gymshark is a community-led fitness apparel brand founded in 2012. We are not just a clothing company — we are a movement built by and for the fitness community. Our brand is defined by authenticity, ambition, and belonging.

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.snippet: - **Energetic but not shouty.** We inspire, we don't hype. - **Warm and peer-level.** We talk to creators like teammates, not vendors. - **Direct and confident.** No filler words, no corporate jargon. - **Inclusive.** Gymshark is for everyone who trains — not just elite athletes.

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.snippet: The following phrases are explicitly banned from all outreach and briefs:  - "amazing" — overused and hollow - "love your content" — sounds copy-pasted - "huge fan" — sycophantic - "perfect fit" — cliché - "came across your page" — impersonal - "inspiring" — vague and overused - "collab" as a noun —

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.snippet: - Real training, real people - Community over competition - Functional performance gear that looks as good as it performs - Sustainability and ethical manufacturing progress - Diversity in fitness — all bodies, all backgrounds

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.section: What Gymshark Does NOT Stand For
chunks.snippet: - Extreme diet culture or dangerous weight loss messaging - Body shaming (any direction) - Steroid use or performance-enhancing drug promotion - Toxic masculinity or exclusionary messaging - Clickbait or dishonest content

chunks.title: Gymshark Brand Voice & Guidelines
chunks.snippet: - Primary colour: Black (#000000) and white (#FFFFFF) - Accent: Gymshark green (#B5FE00 in digital contexts) - Logo: Clean shark fin mark — never distort or recolour - Typography: Clean sans-serif, never decorative fonts in official comms

chunks.title: Campaign Performance Benchmarks
chunks.snippet: A creator is recommended for renewal when: - ROI > 4x AND - Conversion rate > 0.40 AND - Brand safety remained GREEN throughout campaign AND - Audience feedback in comments remained positive

chunks.title: Campaign Performance Benchmarks

chunks.title: Competitor & Conflict of Interest Policy
chunks.snippet: The discovery pipeline flags a creator as `competitor_loyalty = True` when: 1. Transcript or title analysis finds competitor brand names with promotional language 2. Comment analysis reveals audience association with a competitor brand 3. LLM analysis identifies the creator as an active paid partner

chunks.title: Competitor & Conflict of Interest Policy
chunks.snippet: - Creator is listed as brand ambassador or affiliate on competitor website - Creator uses a competitor promo code in recent videos (last 6 months) - Creator has posted sponsored content for a competitor in last 6 months

chunks.title: Competitor & Conflict of Interest Policy
chunks.section: What Does NOT Count as Competitor Loyalty
chunks.snippet: - Creator has worn competitor gear in non-sponsored content - Creator has mentioned a competitor positively in passing - Creator was sponsored by a competitor more than 12 months ago with no renewal

chunks.title: Competitor & Conflict of Interest Policy
chunks.snippet: Brand Ambassador and Co-Created Collection deals include: - **Category exclusivity:** Creator cannot work with direct competitors during contract period - **Duration:** Exclusivity applies for contract duration + 3 months post-contract  Affiliate and Paid Creative deals: - No exclusivity by default

chunks.title: Competitor & Conflict of Interest Policy
chunks.snippet: If a partner is found to be in breach of competitor exclusivity: 1. Partnerships manager notified within 24 hours 2. Creator contacted within 48 hours to discuss 3. If unresolved within 7 days, contract legal review initiated

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: # Creator Outreach Playbook

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: 1. **Be specific, not generic.** Reference something real about their content. 2. **Lead with value, not ask.** Tell them what they get before you ask anything. 3. **Match the energy of their tier.** Nano = warm and casual. Mega = brief and professional. 4. **Never lie or oversell.** Gymshark's repu

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: ### Nano (< 10K subs) - Tone: Warm, peer-level, conversational - Length: Up to 300 words - Ask: Gift with no strings attached - Feel: Like a message from a fellow fitness fan who works at Gymshark  ### Micro (10K–100K subs) - Tone: Friendly but professional - Length: Up to 280 words - Ask: Affiliate

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: 1. **Hook** — one specific observation about their content (not generic praise) 2. **Who we are** — one sentence only, assume they know Gymshark 3. **The offer** — what they get, be specific about the deal type 4. **The ask** — one clear call to action 5. **Sign-off** — name, title, Gymshark Partner

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.section: What to Reference in the Hook
chunks.snippet: Good hooks reference: - A specific video theme or series they do regularly - Their niche authenticity ("the way you document real training progress") - Their community ("your audience clearly trusts your product opinions") - Their content style ("your try-on format gives really honest context")  Bad

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: Never use in any outreach message: - "amazing", "inspiring", "love your content" - "huge fan", "perfect fit", "came across your page" - "collab opportunity", "synergy", "exciting partnership" - Any claim about guaranteed earnings or exposure

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: - **YouTube:** Lead with their video content. Reference workout style or series. - **Instagram:** Reference their visual aesthetic or Reel format. - **TikTok:** Reference their format or trending sounds they use.

chunks.title: Creator Outreach Playbook
chunks.snippet: - Wait 5 business days before following up - One follow-up maximum per outreach cycle - If no response after follow-up, mark as cold in CRM and revisit next quarter
